reviews.title: Watch app time is off
reviews.text: I really wanted to like the app and loved the fact that it had an apple watch widget. Unfortunately the watch widget time is always off.

reviews.title: Great app!
reviews.text: This app is so helpful. It has reminders for adhan, and even you can set reminders when to pray, like 20minutes before sunrise, or 30 minutes before the next prayer, etc. it also has  qibla calculations. Would really recommend.

reviews.title: Literal gigabytes of data transfer
reviews.text:
Why exactly does the app need to transfer gigabytes of data? Now, what exactly are you transferring here? I’m not making any accusations, but I would sure love an explanation as to what the exact nature of the data being transferred out from and into my phone.

EDIT: I’ve reinstalled the app after the supposed “fix” was released, but that did not change a thing. Still transferring gigabytes of data, so at this point this app is just siphoning data.

reviews.title: Uninstalled .. becareful
reviews.text: Wrong prayer timings becareful i just pray isha half an hour before its time and was surprised the athan came later and when i checked google it showed me that the timings are wrong in this app !!!
